stories.title: Anthropic expands access to its strongest models for vetted security teams
stories.summary: Anthropic expanded its Cyber Verification Program into three access tiers for qualifying security professionals. The company says Project Glasswing partners found at least 129,000 verified software vulnerabilities from April through July, including more than 33,000 rated critical or high severity.
stories.why: Frontier AI is becoming a powerful defensive security tool, while providers are experimenting with controlled access for advanced capabilities.

stories.title: Gears of War: E-Day launches worldwide
stories.summary: The Coalition's Gears of War: E-Day launched October 6 on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox PC, Steam and Game Pass. The prequel returns to the opening hours of Emergence Day with Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago and is rebuilt on Unreal Engine 5.
stories.why: It is one of October's biggest PC and Xbox releases and a major first-party launch for Microsoft.

stories.title: Vietnamese banks plan nearly $7 billion in share sales
stories.summary: Vietnamese banks are planning nearly $7 billion in share sales as rapid credit growth and an economy expanding at nearly 10% increase capital needs. Foreign ownership and offshore borrowing rules have also been partly loosened.
stories.why: The fundraising shows both the strength and pressure created by Vietnam's rapid growth, while giving international investors a wider opening into the banking sector.

stories.title: AMD plans a substantial chip-supply increase for 2027
stories.summary: AMD CEO Lisa Su said the company plans to substantially increase chip supply in 2027 as AI demand grows, while working with major Asian manufacturing and memory suppliers to expand capacity.
stories.why: AMD is Nvidia's main large-scale GPU challenger, so higher supply could improve competition and availability across AI infrastructure.

stories.title: AI-generated vulnerability spam is straining open-source bug bounty programs
stories.summary: Google has temporarily paused monetary rewards in an open-source vulnerability program after reviewers were overwhelmed by automated submissions, many containing invalid or hallucinated vulnerability claims.
stories.why: Cheap automated reports impose a new review burden on maintainers and show why AI-assisted security research needs better verification and reputation mechanisms.
